notes:
Describes things that are characteristic of an early, undeveloped stage. Can be used objectively in academic contexts (referring to early human societies or basic organisms) or judgmentally to criticize something as unsophisticated. Can also carry a positive nuance when emphasizing the appeal of simplicity or closeness to nature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原始的|げんしてき}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: primitive lifestyle
- {原始的|げんしてき}な⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: primitive society
- {原始的|げんしてき}な⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧: primitive tools
- {原始的|げんしてき}な⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: primitive method
- {原始的|げんしてき}な⟦{本能|ほんのう}→本能：07623_honnou⟧: primal instinct

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{未開|みかい}→未開：18451_mikai⟧: uncivilized, undeveloped — stronger negative judgment; considered potentially offensive when describing peoples
- ⟦{素朴|そぼく}→素朴：06071_soboku⟧: simple, unsophisticated — positive nuance emphasizing natural charm or sincerity
- ⟦{初歩的|しょほてき}→初歩的：10124_shohoteki⟧: elementary, basic — describes a beginner level, not an ancient or undeveloped state

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of ⟦{原始|げんし}→原始：00067_genshi⟧ (origin, beginning) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix). {原|げん} means origin and {始|し} means beginning.

definitions.explanation: resembling or characteristic of an early stage of development; lacking modern sophistication or technology; basic and undeveloped
